expectations.text: Includes offline notes and automatic sync after connection returns without promising offline photos.
expectations.evidence: "You can now keep taking notes offline, and they'll sync when your connection returns." The separate sentence "Photos still need a connection" prevents an offline-photo promise.

expectations.text: Retains all-plan inclusion and no migration for existing notebooks.
expectations.evidence: "Offline notes are included on every plan, and your existing notebooks need no migration."

expectations.text: Does not invent quotations, adoption numbers, performance measures, launch offers, or founder experiences beyond the supplied facts.
expectations.evidence: "Customers told us they were losing notes in basements" is supplied background. "Thanks to the customers" adds a permissible expression of gratitude; no quotation, metric, discount, or invented founder experience appears.

expectations.text: 90–140 words; reads as a publishable post without assistant wrapper.
expectations.evidence: 100 whitespace-delimited words; starts "Today we added offline notes" and ends "where Fieldnote was letting them down," with no assistant wrapper.

review_method: Independent single blind agent review; not human feedback
